scenes.text: Boss. It's {subject.first}'s manager. So... the cops clocked {him} doing 142 in a school zone. On a Sunday. In a borrowed Lamborghini. {He} told the officer {he} was 'cutting weight'.
scenes.speaker: {subject.manager}

choices.label: Pay the lawyer to make it disappear ({$fee})
choices.result: The ticket evaporates. {subject.first} sends you a thumbs-up emoji and a picture of a new car.

choices.label: Let {him} deal with it {him}self
choices.result: {subject.first} pays the fine in rolls of quarters. The clerk posts it online.

choices.label: Make {him} film a 'Drive Safe' PSA for local schools
choices.result: The PSA is 40 seconds long. {subject.first} breaks character twice to laugh. It gets 3 million views. Mostly ironic.

scenes.text: {subject.first} {subject.last} crashed into two parked cars and a third car that was not parked, then left on foot. Then came back for {his} phone. The police have {him}. Nobody was killed, but someone is in the hospital.
scenes.speaker: Your head of security

choices.label: Suspend {him} indefinitely, pending the investigation
choices.result: You put out a short statement. No jokes. The press calls it 'unusually adult'.

choices.label: Wait for all the facts before acting
choices.result: 'We're waiting for the facts.' The facts arrive in the form of dashcam footage on every news channel.

choices.label: Publicly back your fighter
choices.result: 'He's a good kid.' Three sponsors call within the hour. None of them say 'good kid'.

scenes.text: PEOPLE v. {subject.last}. The DA offers a plea: reckless driving and leaving the scene, 18 months probation, restitution, 200 hours of community service. {He}'d be free to compete after a 6-month suspension.
scenes.title: PLEA OFFER (CARBON COPY)

choices.label: Advise {him} to take it
choices.result: {subject.first} takes the deal. {He} does community service at an animal shelter and is somehow great at it.

choices.label: Pay for a trial lawyer to fight it ({$fee})
choices.result: The shark lawyer gets it knocked down to a misdemeanor. The victim's family gives a press conference. It is not a good press conference for you.

scenes.text: {subject.first} is back in your office, clean-shaven, carrying a book about accountability {he} has clearly not read. {He} wants to fight again.
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} {subject.last}

choices.label: Book {him} on a big card: redemption sells
choices.result: The redemption arc trends for a week. The victim's lawyer trends for slightly longer.

choices.label: Bring {him} back quietly on a prelim
choices.result: Quiet comeback. A win by decision. Nobody makes a documentary. Good.

choices.label: Release {him}
choices.result: You let {him} go. {He} signs with a bare-knuckle league within 48 hours.

scenes.text: We've got a problem. {subject.first} got into it at a bar called The Rusty Spur. Guy said he 'could take a pro fighter'. He could not. Cops are there now.
scenes.speaker: {subject.manager}

choices.label: Let the Bail Office handle it
choices.result: Another ticket for the Bail Office window.

choices.label: Call in a favor with the local sheriff ({$fee} 'donation')
choices.result: The sheriff is suddenly a huge fan of the sport. Charges 'misplaced'. A deputy asks for ringside seats.

scenes.text: Phone footage of {subject.last}'s bar fight is everywhere. 14 million views. The comments section has scored it 10-8 and is demanding a rematch with the bouncer.

choices.label: Lean into it: sell 'Last Call' T-shirts
choices.result: The shirts sell out. The commission sends a letter written entirely in capital letters.

choices.label: Issue a stern statement
choices.result: 'We do not condone violence outside of a licensed, sanctioned, pay-per-view context.'

choices.label: Make {him} apologize to the guy publicly
choices.result: The apology is sincere. The guy accepts it, then hires a lawyer anyway.

scenes.text: PLAINTIFF Darrel K. Mumford v. {subject.last} and {promotion}. Damages sought: {$amount} for 'emotional distress, a chipped tooth, and the loss of a lifelong belief that I could take a pro fighter'.
scenes.title: SUMMONS

choices.label: Settle ({$amount})
choices.result: Settled. Darrel buys a boat. He names it 'TKO'.

choices.label: Fight it in court
choices.result: It goes to court. The jury is mostly people who have also thought they could take a pro fighter.

scenes.text: {subject.first} got pulled over at 3am with a blood alcohol level that should have killed a horse. {He} offered the officer a signed glove. The officer is a boxing fan.
scenes.speaker: {subject.manager}

choices.label: Send the Bail Office paperwork
choices.result: Another mugshot for the collection.

choices.label: Get ahead of it: announce {he}'s entering rehab
choices.result: You announce rehab before {he} knows about it. {He} finds out from Twitter.

scenes.text: {subject.first} shows up hungover, still wearing the hospital bracelet from the drunk tank. {His} coach is with {him}. The coach says {he} needs 60 days in rehab. {subject.first} says {he} needs a fight in three weeks.
scenes.speaker: {subject.coach}

choices.label: Pay for 60 days of rehab ({$fee})
choices.result: {subject.first} goes to a facility in the desert with horses. {He} names one of the horses after you. It's not a compliment, but it's not not a compliment.

choices.label: Book the fight. Work is the best rehab.
choices.result: 'Work is the best rehab,' you say, to a man currently drinking a beer at 10am.

choices.label: Make it {his} problem
choices.result: {He} leaves. Unclear where to. Unclear sober.

scenes.text: {subject.first} is back: clear-eyed, eight pounds of muscle heavier, and drinking sparkling water like it owes {him} money. {He} wants a main event to prove {he}'s a new person.
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} {subject.last}

choices.label: Give {him} the spotlight
choices.result: 'The New {subject.last}.' The promo package makes the network cry.

choices.label: Ease {him} back in
choices.result: A sensible fight on a sensible card. Growth.

scenes.text: Police were called to {subject.first} {subject.last}'s home last night after a domestic incident was reported. {He} has been arrested. There are no details yet beyond the police report.
scenes.speaker: Your general counsel

choices.label: Suspend {him} immediately and cooperate fully with authorities
choices.result: You suspend {him} and refer the matter to the authorities. The promotion makes a donation to a domestic-violence support organization. It is the right call.

choices.label: Pull {him} from all events while the case proceeds
choices.result: {He} is pulled from all events while the legal process plays out.

choices.label: Keep {him} on the upcoming card
choices.result: Keeping {him} on the card becomes the story. Sponsors, the commission and most of the internet respond in exactly the way you'd expect.

scenes.text: The criminal case against {subject.last} has concluded. Your general counsel recommends a decision on {his} future with the promotion.
scenes.title: LEGAL MEMO

choices.label: Release {him}
choices.result: {subject.last} is released. You decline to elaborate beyond a short statement.

choices.label: Lift the suspension, with mandatory counselling
choices.result: {He} returns with conditions. Some sponsors do not return with {him}.

title: A Letter From the Tax People

scenes.text: FINAL NOTICE. The tax authority informs {subject.first} {subject.last} that {he} has not filed returns since {his} third pro fight. Amount owed including penalties: {$owed}. {He} has forwarded this letter to you with the message 'lol help'.
scenes.title: OFFICIAL NOTICE

choices.label: Lend {him} the money against future purses
choices.result: You pay the government. {subject.first} promises to pay you back. {He} immediately buys a jet ski.

choices.label: Send {him} to your accountant
choices.result: Your accountant meets {subject.first} for three hours. The accountant then takes a week off.

choices.label: Not your problem
choices.result: You say 'not my problem'. That is, in fact, a famous last sentence.

scenes.text: {subject.first} comes in with a duffel bag. Inside: some cash, a Rolex, three NFTs printed out on paper, and a promise.
scenes.speaker: {subject.first} {subject.last}

choices.label: Take what's there
choices.result: You get half your money back and a printed NFT of a cartoon ape. You frame it.

choices.label: Forgive the rest
choices.result: {He} hugs you and cries. The whole gym hears about it. Good PR. Bad accounting.

scenes.text: Federal agents just searched {subject.first}'s house. They took computers, boxes of paperwork, and a gold-plated title belt replica. {He} is not under arrest. Yet.
scenes.speaker: {subject.manager}

choices.label: Pay for a tax lawyer ({$fee})
choices.result: The tax lawyer charges by the minute and talks very slowly.

choices.label: Distance the promotion
choices.result: '{promotion} has no involvement in Mr. {subject.last}'s personal finances,' says the statement, written on a computer {subject.last} bought with company money.

scenes.text: {subject.last} pleads guilty to tax evasion. Sentence: repayment plan, fines, and probation. {He} can keep fighting, but every purse will now be garnished by the government.
scenes.title: COURT RECORD

choices.label: Restructure {his} contract so it's survivable
choices.result: The tax authority is now {his} biggest fan. They attend every fight. They take 40%.

choices.label: Use it as leverage: lower {his} purse
choices.result: {He} signs, because what else is {he} going to do.

scenes.text: {subject.first} fought a TSA agent at the airport over a 32-ounce jug of pre-workout. {He} called it 'a supplement, not a liquid'. The agent called it 'a liquid'. {He} is in an airport holding room.
scenes.speaker: Your travel coordinator

choices.label: Bail Office
choices.result: Paperwork incoming.

choices.label: Charter {him} a private jet next time ({$fee})
choices.result: Private jets: the only airline with no rules and no TSA.

scenes.text: VIDEO: {subject.last} grabs a fan's phone at Applebee's and smashes it into 30 pieces. The fan had been filming {him} eating riblets. The riblets were later described as 'excellent'.

choices.label: Pay the fan for a new phone and a gag order ({$fee})
choices.result: The fan gets a new phone, two front-row seats and a lawyer's letter. He posts about the seats.

choices.label: Let the cops handle it
choices.result: {He} spends a night in a cell next to a man arrested for the same thing at a Chili's.

choices.label: Make {him} apologize and buy the guy riblets
choices.result: They eat riblets together on camera. It's weirdly touching.

scenes.text: Airport security found a handgun in {subject.first}'s gym bag. {He} says it was 'for bears'. {He} was flying to Miami.
scenes.speaker: Your head of security

choices.label: Bail Office
choices.result: It's a whole thing.

choices.label: Suspend {him} for a month on top
choices.result: The commission likes the suspension. The bears are relieved.

scenes.text: Routine traffic stop. Officers found enough party favors in {subject.first}'s glovebox to stock a music festival. {He} says the glovebox belongs to {his} cousin. It's {his} car. {He} doesn't have a cousin.
scenes.speaker: {subject.manager}

choices.label: Bail Office, then mandatory rehab
choices.result: Paperwork and a rehab brochure, together at last.

choices.label: Bail Office and hope it goes away
choices.result: It does not go away.

title: Come Down Here and Say That

scenes.text: A heckler at {subject.first}'s public workout yelled 'you're washed!'. {subject.first} went over the barricade. The heckler is fine. The barricade is not. Neither is {subject.first}'s legal situation.
scenes.speaker: Your event manager

choices.label: Bail Office
choices.result: Weirdly, ticket sales go up.

choices.label: Pay off the heckler before charges ({$fee})
choices.result: The heckler suddenly 'doesn't want to press charges'. He also suddenly owns a boat.

scenes.text: {subject.first} drag raced a car at a red light. The car was an unmarked police cruiser. {He} won the race. {He} lost everything else.
scenes.speaker: {subject.manager}

choices.label: Bail Office
choices.result: The dashcam clip is the most-watched thing {he} has ever done, including fights.

choices.label: Sell the dashcam rights to a car show ({$fee})
choices.result: The car show buys it. The commission buys a stress ball.

scenes.text: {subject.first} showed up at {his} rival's gym at 3am 'to talk'. The rival was not there. A janitor was. {subject.first} talked to the janitor for two hours. The janitor called the police.
scenes.speaker: {subject.manager}

choices.label: Bail Office
choices.result: The janitor goes viral. He gets a podcast.

choices.label: Turn it into the promo for the fight
choices.result: 'He came to MY HOUSE.' The poster writes itself.

scenes.text: Someone spray-painted 'SOFT' and a crude anatomical drawing across a billboard of {subject.last}'s next opponent. Security cameras show it was {subject.last}. {He} also signed it.

choices.label: Pay for the billboard ({$fee})
choices.result: The billboard company is paid. The drawing is now an NFT.

choices.label: Let the cops have {him}
choices.result: {He} gets community service cleaning billboards. {He} cleans {his} own billboard first.

scenes.text: CLASS ACTION: 400 members of '{subject.last} Elite MMA & Smoothie Bar' allege they paid for 'lifetime memberships' before the gym closed after nine days. The gym is now a vape shop. Also owned by {subject.last}.
scenes.title: NOTICE OF CLASS ACTION

choices.label: Refund the members from promotion funds ({$fee})
choices.result: Members get refunds and a free ticket. Some become fans. Most remain furious.

choices.label: Let {him} go to court
choices.result: Court it is.

scenes.text: {subject.first} missed a court date because {he} was at a fight camp in Thailand. The judge has issued a bench warrant. {He} lands in four hours.
scenes.speaker: Your general counsel

choices.label: Have a lawyer meet {him} at the airport ({$fee})
choices.result: The lawyer greets {him} with a sign reading 'YOU ARE UNDER ARREST (SORT OF)'.

choices.label: Tell {him} to stay in Thailand a while
choices.result: {He} stays in Thailand for two months. {His} Muay Thai improves. {His} legal situation does not.

scenes.text: Funny story. A {doc} you buried a while back just landed on a reporter's desk. The reporter is calling everyone. Including your mother.
scenes.speaker: Your general counsel

choices.label: Deny everything
choices.result: 'I've never seen that document in my life.' Your fingerprints have.

choices.label: Own it and pay the fine ({$fine})
choices.result: You pay the fine and say 'mistakes were made'. Passive voice, the champion of executives.

choices.label: Blame an intern
choices.result: The intern is very upset. The intern also has screenshots.

scenes.text: A lab tech says {subject.last}'s failed test was buried. She has emails, timestamps and a very calm voice. She's talking to The Pathetic tomorrow unless someone gives her a reason not to.
scenes.speaker: Anonymous caller

choices.label: Come clean: suspend {subject.last} now
choices.result: It's ugly, but it's over. Mostly.

choices.label: Offer her a 'consulting role' ({$fee})
choices.result: She accepts. Her first consulting report is titled 'Why You Should Be In Prison'.

choices.label: Ignore her
choices.result: The Pathetic runs it on the front page. Part one of four.

scenes.text: Turns out your 'consultant' kept copies of everything, including the payment. A federal prosecutor would like to discuss your 'consulting arrangements'.
scenes.title: SUBPOENA

choices.label: Lawyer up ({$fee})
choices.result: The lawyers lawyer. Everyone lawyers.

choices.label: Cooperate fully
choices.result: You cooperate. The board is livid. The prosecutor is delighted.

scenes.text: The commission has reviewed weigh-in footage showing an official's hand on the scale during {subject.last}'s weigh-in. There is a lot of finger. They want an explanation.
scenes.title: COMMISSION INQUIRY

choices.label: Blame a 'technical malfunction'
choices.result: They do not believe in technical malfunctions that wear wedding rings.

choices.label: Pay the fine and fire the official ({$fine})
choices.result: Someone takes the fall. It isn't you. This time.

scenes.text: {subject.first} won't fight until {he} gets a raise. {He}'s posting cryptic pictures of a boxing ring and a crypto exchange logo. {His} manager says {he}'s 'exploring options'.
scenes.speaker: {subject.manager}

choices.label: Give {him} a 25% raise
choices.result: {He} posts a picture of a check with your face drawn on it. Affectionately.

choices.label: Call {his} bluff
choices.result: {He} sits out. The internet takes sides. Your side is smaller.

choices.label: Strip {him} of rankings and bench {him}
choices.result: Benched. The locker room is quietly furious.
